## Purpose
`ProjectDetail.tsx` and `SessionDetail.tsx` are the two route-level "detail" pages: each is reached via a route param (`useParams<{ id: string }>()`), resolves its subject from store/query state, and renders it inside the shared `PageSurface` + `EditorialBand` shell. Both open with a header comment explaining what the page replaced/reuses (SessionDetail explicitly notes it reuses `<ExecutionTrace>` rather than duplicating a flat-events view) and how live updates reach the page (watcher invalidation, not polling).

## Convention
Folder: apps/dashboard/src/pages/** · Extension: .tsx · Files of this role in this subproject: 2
A detail page always guards on its subject being resolvable BEFORE rendering the main body: `SessionDetail` early-returns an `EmptyState` when `projectsRoot` is absent, `ProjectDetail` early-returns one when the project id does not resolve. Hooks are called unconditionally above any early return (both pages call `useActiveProjectName()`/`useProject()` before the guard), never behind a conditional, to respect the Rules of Hooks. The page composes exclusively `@/components/page` primitives (`PageSurface`, `EditorialBand`, `EmptyState`, `DataCard`, ...) for chrome — no raw `style={{}}` or ad hoc colors, per the pages guard.

## How to apply
A new detail page lives at `src/pages/XxxDetail.tsx`, reads its id via `useParams`, resolves the subject from an existing store/query (never a fresh ad hoc fetch bypassing the established hook), and early-returns `<PageSurface><EmptyState .../></PageSurface>` for the "not found" / "no active project" case before rendering the `EditorialBand` + body. Route it under the plural page's list (e.g. `/sessions/:id` from `Sessions.tsx`).

## Examples
Ref: apps/dashboard/src/pages/SessionDetail.tsx
```tsx
export function SessionDetail() {
  const { id: rawId } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const sessionId = rawId ? decodeURIComponent(rawId) : "";
  const projectsRoot = useStore((s) => s.projectsRoot);
  const activeProjectName = useActiveProjectName();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  if (!projectsRoot) {
    return (
      <PageSurface>
        <EmptyState
          title="Nenhum projeto ativo"
          description="Selecione um projeto na barra lateral para ver esta sessão."
        />
      </PageSurface>
    );
  }
```
